The '''Sirdar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sirdar]].
